defaultOpen.name: Default Open
defaultOpen.description: Whether the modal is open by default (uncontrolled).

isDismissable.name: Dismissable
isDismissable.description: Whether the modal can be dismissed by clicking outside it.

isKeyboardDismissDisabled.name: Keyboard Dismiss Disabled
isKeyboardDismissDisabled.description: Whether pressing the Escape key to close the modal is disabled.

isEntering.name: Is Entering
isEntering.description: Whether the modal is currently performing an entry animation.

isExiting.name: Is Exiting
isExiting.description: Whether the modal is currently performing an exit animation.
